messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in prod (region-us-east-1). P50 latency spike 2.1s -> 5s. Paging Mike (primary oncall) and Elsa (secondary). See /incidents/2003

mike: on it, joining call. starting triage — collecting logs. what's the customer impact?

elsa: i'm secondary. if this is infra (node OOM or network) i'll take. pinging @infra-oncall.

jana: support here, we have 3 customer tickets referencing failures and 2 timeouts from big customer acme-corp. attaching sample trace ids: trace/0a1b2c

mike: quick checks: cpu across GPU hosts looks ok, but nginx upstream 502 count spiked. running: ```kubectl -n prod logs -l app=ingress --tail=200``` and checking envoy counters.

infra-oncall: seeing a config rollout around 02:10 UTC, could be nginx reloads. pulling kube events. If it's just ingress, runtime team owns model servers but infra handles networking.

mike: good point. @infra-oncall can you confirm if there was a canary or daemonset change? also @security-oncall pls confirm no suspicious access.

infra-oncall: confirmed: a canary rolled at 02:09 (ingress-controller:v2.3.1). 10% of nodes had failed L7 healthchecks for ~3min. rolling back to v2.3.0 now.

mike: switching routing to fallback model behind /v1/generate-fast to reduce load while rollback completes. Runbook link: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/ingress-502 (follow step 2 and step 5)

elsa: taking secondary for the next hour — mike go to sleep? :) I'll monitor metrics and escalate to platform-sre if rollback doesn't finish in 10m.

mike: Handoff notes: primary=mike (until 03:00 UTC), secondary=elsa. Coverage gap: 03:00-04:00 UTC currently unassigned. @helen can you cover 03:00? if not we'll need follow-up rotation.

helen: I can cover 03:00-04:30 UTC. will stay on watch and check the post-rollback metrics in Grafana dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/prod/ingress

support-bot: Noted — customer tickets updated: #4321, #4322 assigned to support oncall. Alerted account team for acme-corp.

security-oncall: no anomalous auth activity. confirming no compromised keys. continuing to monitor.

mike: rollback succeeded at 02:18 UTC, error rate back to baseline around 02:25. Closing incident in 30m after postmortem prep. Action items: 1) add ingress canary healthcheck alert, 2) update runbook with rollback timeout. I'll create a follow-up PR.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (temp): 5xx rate normalized. Incident thread will be archived. :white_check_mark:

jana: thx all — notes saved to /incidents/2003/postmortem-draft

elsa: leaving a note: primary->mike, secondary->elsa, infra handled rollback, runtime on standby. cross-team routing: ingress/networking infra, model runtime for backend errors. keep that mapping in runbook.

mike: appreciated. handing primary to helen at 03:00 UTC per plan. Good job everyone :tada:
